title: Leipziger Buchmesse
description: We spent a lovely time at the Leipziger Buchmesse, taking in all the sights and buying (maybe) too many books. After our visit to the Leipziger Buchmesse we were invited to a lovely dinner hosted by the Schöne Bücher Collective that introduced us to some fun new indie publishing houses.

title: Frankfurter Buchmesse
description: After visiting the Frankfurter Buchmesse for the first time we found a whole new appreciation for personal space. Next time we will go on a less busy day, instead of the bustling weekend.

title: Chest of Fandoms Creator Event
description: The team from Chest of Fandoms invited us to a lovely Creator Event for their brand ambassadors.

title: Chest of Fandoms Creator Event: Mythical Creatures
description: We celebrated the launch of Chest of Fandoms first Pop-Up Store in Cologne dressed to the nines.

title: Chest of Fandoms Christmas Open House
description: The team from Chest of Fandoms invited us to a lovely Christmas Event for their brand ambassadors. However disaster struck on the way back when our train was cancelled and we spent 3 hours in an freezing train station. Luckily our books distracted us from the impending frostbite

title: Lessons in Falling: Book Launch
description: We spent a wonderful evening at the book launch of Selina Mae's new book Lessons in Falling, bedazilling and chatting the night away.
